title: Dynamic Email Retargeting
facebook_comment_text: Capturing real-time user context isn't just about cookies; it's the intelligent orchestration of browser behavior, device IDs, and engagement patterns to *predict intent*. That's where hyper-personalization truly shines, delivering content that feels custom-made, not generic. 💡 What specific data signals are currently proving most elusive but impactful in your lead nurturing efforts? 👇
